# NOVA mini – T1 PACK: the final internal packaging of the torso and base (for the exterior designers)

**Origin.** This is concept **K2 "off-axis gears, compact"**, the winner of the judgement in `T1/hodnotenie.md` (74 vs 64
points), plus grafts from **K3 "J1 in the base"** and the judge's must-fix items. It is the ONE packaging the exterior form
variants must enclose.

**Files** in `/tmp/claude-0/gapwf/fin/T1/pack/`:
* `layout.json` – the t1lib layout, generated by `gen_layout.py`.
* `check.json` – every check, re-run on this layout.
* `envelope.json` – the minimum interior per 5 mm slice, plus the fixed interfaces. **This is the contract for the exterior.**
* `pack_changes.json` – what changed against K2.
* `prev_*.png` – previews with the real B head. The rest pose and the awake pose (lift 12.5, tilt 10, pan 30, arms 60/−20) are shown as iso, front, side and cut, plus full sections `prev_*_rez_cut_side/front.png`.

**Frame:** world mm, Z up, floor z = 0, FRONT = −Y, robot RIGHT = −X.

All shells in the layout are **soft placeholders**: torso superellipse n 2.35 with R16 edges, base n 2.35 with R10 edges,
arms rf 11.4 pills. They only prove that the internals fit a soft, modern body of R01 size. The final exterior form is
free within `envelope.json`.

## 1. Joints

### J1 – torso yaw ±150° (hard stops ±155°)
* **Actuator.** Feetech STS3215, 7.4 V version.
  * 19.5 kg·cm ≈ 1.9 N·m stall; 12-bit magnetic encoder over 360°.
  * 45.2 × 24.7 × 35, 55 g, 25T Ø5.9 spline.
  * Footprint, mass and spline confirmed by DFRobot, Mouser and servodatabase listings (high confidence). The height is taken as the larger envelope, 35 + 2.6 mm boss.
  * Mounted in the torso, shaft down at (−18, 0). The two 5264 plugs and their bend are reserved at x +15.7…+27.
* **Why off the axis.** With the shaft on the axis, the plug end lands at x ≈ 44.7, outside the soft interior (42.3). The 18 mm offset keeps the servo and its plugs inside x −29.5…+27.
* **Transmission.** 1:1 external spur pair, m1.0, 18T/18T, C 18.0, face 3.2. **Both gears brass.**
  * The sun gear sits on the static hub through a **slip clutch**: wave spring + friction ring, slip ≈ 0.25 N·m.
  * The pinion (25T female spline + M3 screw) orbits with the torso.
  * Firmware: STS3215 torque limit 15 %. A slip shows in the load register, and the robot then re-homes at low torque on the ±155° stop.
  * Backlash ≈ 0.2° after setting the slotted servo cradle (±0.3 mm on the centre distance); approach targets from one side.
* **Bearing.** 6805-2RS, 25 × 37 × 7.
  * The inner ring sits on the static hub: a POM collet on a steel M8 core, standing on the **13 × 6 PETG beam** between the battery groups.
  * The outer ring is in the rotating foot ring, r 18.5–20.5.
  * The bearing carries the weight and the tipping moments; the pinion floats axially by 0.3 mm.
* **Torque.** ≈ 0.03 N·m needed (inertia 6·10⁻⁴ kg·m², 90° in 0.6 s, plus seal and mesh friction) against 1.9 N·m stall and 0.29 N·m at the 15 % limit. No holding torque on a vertical axis.

### PAN – head yaw ±85° (±90° mechanical)
* **Actuator.** Feetech STS3032 bus servo with a 360° magnetic encoder.
  * 23.2 × 12.1 × 28.5, 20 g (listings, medium confidence; envelope 23.5 × 12.5, tabs 32.5).
  * Static at the torso front, shaft up at (0, −21.6).
* **Transmission.** Pinion m0.8 18T → 36T gear on the pan stage, 2:1, C 21.6, POM, face 3.2/3.5.
  * Only the ~200° sector that can face the pinion is toothed; the rest is a smooth drum for the FPC loop.
  * Resolution 0.044°/step.
* **Bearings.**
  * Bottom: a Ø6 steel pin fixed in the deck + bronze sleeve, and a PTFE thrust washer.
  * Top: a **dedicated Ø56.4 journal** around the well (z 118.5–124.5) in a POM-lined ring of the frame.
  * The supports are 36 mm apart.
* **Stops.** A pin in a 180° arc slot of the deck → ±90°; firmware ±85°.
* **Torque.** 0.026 N·m needed against 0.72 N·m at the gear (28×). Backlash ≈ 0.6°; option: a 0.01 N·m bias spring.

### LIFT – neck 0…20 mm
* **Actuator.** MG90S (22.8 × 12.2 × 28.5, 13.4 g) on the pan stage behind the well. Shaft along X at (y 19.1, z 104.8); the lower tab is cut off.
* **Mechanism.** A POM crank r 10 drives a Ø2 steel pin in a 2.2 × 12.2 slot in the **ear** of the POM neck foot.
  * The foot is a new part screwed under the B neck. The ear passes through a 4.5 mm window in the well's back wall.
  * lift = 10·(1 − cos θ). **Dead centres at rest and at full lift.**
  * The well (47 × 22 with PTFE strips) is the linear guide.
* **Torque.** 0.026 N·m max (mid-stroke) against 0.177 N·m (6.8×).
  * Holding at the awake pose 12.5 mm: 0.025 N·m. Hum risk; option: dead-centre-only rest poses.

### TILT – unchanged (B rev. E2)
MG90S in the neck, with the B tilt-vs-lift table. The real-head check against this torso top was done in K2 and is
still valid, because the torso top did not change: ≥ 0.45 mm over the collar plateau (B criterion ≥ 0.25), and the real
lugs clear the well by 1.0 mm (`head_real_check.json`).

### ARMS – one slim servo inside each paddle
* **Actuator.** EMAX ES9052MD class: 19.9 × 8.8 × 26.35, 5.5 g, 1.3 kg·cm @ 6 V (some listings 0.65). Envelope 21 case + 5.35 boss along X, 20.5 × 9.4.
  * The case is fixed in the paddle (flush with the inner face, bonded to the 2.0 mm outer wall).
  * The spline sits in a **static spline socket with a friction collar ≈ 0.25 N·m** on the side column of the torso frame.
  * The arm pulls off sideways (magnetic detent) for service.
* **Range.** −45…+135 (180° servo travel – verify 500–2500 µs on purchase).
  * The upper limit depends on the head pose: the firmware clamps to `check.json → arm_limit_table_deg` (≥ 2 mm to the head).
  * Right arm at pan 0: 102° at rest, 125° at lift 20, 95–98° while the head nods down.
  * With the head panned ≥ 60° away, the full 135° is free.
* **Torque.** Paddle 14.7 g (2.0 mm wall) + cap 1.0 g, CoG 26 mm below the axis:
  * 0.0041 N·m holding at 90°;
  * + 0.0021 N·m to accelerate 90° in 0.25 s;
  * = **0.0062 N·m** against 0.108 N·m @ 5 V (17×). Even with the low 0.65 kg·cm listing it is 10×.
* **Clearances.** See §4.

### WHEELS, CASTERS, SENSORS
* **Drive.** 2 × N20 6 V 1:150 with magnetic encoders. Envelope: 34 motor + 8 encoder + 5 plug, the larger envelope. Tyred wheels Ø32 × 9 at x ±54, axle z 16, DRV8833. About 16× torque margin.
* **Casters.** 2 × 3/8″ ball casters at (0, ±34), **screwed into the battery-bay covers**. The support polygon is a diamond whose edges are 28.8 mm from the centre.
* **Cliff sensors.** 4 × ITR8307 at **(±40, ±31)** in the corner pockets, outside the battery bays, with 9 × 7 windows in the bottom.
* **Other sensors and lights.** VL53L1X ToF behind a dark window at the front (y −52.8, z 28.5); base light bar 44 × 4 at z 20.

## 2. Cable routing

**J1 – 6 conductors, ±155° hard stop, laid out for ±170°.**
* Conductors: VBAT ×2, GND ×2, servo/node bus, wake/spare.
* Custom polyimide FPC 6.0 × 0.15 mm, 2 oz Cu (VBAT/GND traces 1.3 mm, signals 0.4).
* Path: static anchor on the outer channel wall (r 32.5) → outer run → U-turn (centreline R ≈ 5.3, ≈ 35× thickness) → inner run on the rotating foot ring (r 20.5) → up through the torso floor at r ≈ 20 → JST-GH 6p.
* The U-turn travels 0.40 × Δθ. **≈ 110 mm in the channel** for ±170° (+ 2 × 15 mm leads). No slip ring, no twist.

**PAN + LIFT – 8 conductors.**
* Conductors: head 4 (5 V_H, GND_H, TX, RX) + servos 4 (5 V_S, GND_S, PWM tilt, PWM lift).
* **One custom 2-layer polyimide FPC, 3.0 mm wide × 0.12 mm**, standing on edge:
  * top layer: 4 power traces of 0.45 mm (≈ 1 A each);
  * bottom layer: 4 signal traces of 0.2 mm.
* Path:
  1. The 7 B wires leave the neck bottom (x 13.8) and are soldered to the FPC tail in a channel of the POM foot.
  2. Foot +X end → window in the well +X end wall → **lift loop**: a vertical U in the YZ plane on the outside of that wall (envelope x 25.3–28.4, y ±4, z 89.5–113, bend R ≈ 3.5 ≈ 29×). The U-turn rises 10 mm for 20 mm of lift.
  3. Down under the well → rotating anchor on the smooth drum sector of the pan gear → **pan rolling loop**: inner run on the drum (r 15.7), U-turn R 5.2 (≈ 43×), outer run on the static back-half wall (r 26.1).
  4. Static anchor → through the deck → JST-SH 4p + 4p on the controller.
* The lift-servo leads join on the pan stage through a 2 × 3 pin micro-junction.
* Everything stays in the back half, away from the pan pinion.

**Arms.** 3 × AWG30 per arm in a one-turn flat spiral in the shoulder pocket (r 7.5–12.5, |x| 41.2–43.2), JST-SH 3p inside the torso.

## 3. Electronics and power
```
 2S2P 18650 3500 mAh (7.2 V nom, 6.0–8.4 V, ≈ 50 Wh) ── 2S BMS 8–10 A (balance) ── AO4407A main switch (back)
   │ base                                         │ J1 rolling FPC (VBAT×2, GND×2, BUS, WAKE)
   ├ DRV8833 → 2× N20 (PWM-limited to 6 V)        │ torso
   ├ D24V10F5 5 V/1 A → RP2040-Zero node:        ├ STS3215 J1 (VBAT direct, bus ID 1)
   │   encoders (PIO), 4× ITR8307 cliff (ADC),   ├ D36V28F5 5 V/≈3 A + 470 µF → 5 V rail:
   │   VL53L1X ToF (I2C), base LED bar           │     head (5 V_H, UART 1 Mbps via the pan FPC), tilt + lift MG90S,
   └ IP2326 2S charger ← USB-C 5 V/2 A (back)     │     2× arm ES9052MD, pan STS3032 (bus ID 2), ESP32-S3-Zero,
                                                  │     torso LED bar, MAX98357A → Ø28 speaker
                                                  └ ESP32-S3-Zero: UART head, half-duplex bus, 4× PWM, I2S, LED
```
* **5 V rail.**
  * Typical draw 0.55–0.7 A; firmware-capped peak 2.5–3.0 A.
  * **Sequencing rule** (graft K3): never two micro-servos stalled or accelerating at the same time; audio peaks are buffered by the 470 µF.
* **Charging and run-while-charging** (policy grafted from K3).
  * The IP2326 has no power path. The robot may run in a **dock mode ≤ 3 W** while charging.
  * The base node watches VBAT. At ≥ 8.35 V it sends the robot to sleep (< 50 mA), so the charger can terminate and the cells never float at 4.2 V.
  * Charge state is shown on the base LED bar and a small LED at the port.
  * Phase-2 option: an NVDC power-path charger.

| power at the battery | idle (awake, no motion) | typical | peak (< 1 s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| head board + LCD + ears (K2 1.25 / K3 1.5) | 1.25–1.6 W | 1.6–1.9 | 2.5 |
| torso MCU + bus driver | 0.20 | 0.25 | 0.4 |
| STS3215 / STS3032 | 0.23 | 0.45 | 7.4 + 2.0 |
| 4 micro servos (lift holding at 12.5 mm) | 0.28 | 0.6 | (5 V cap) |
| LED bars (20 %) | 0.20 | 0.25 | 1.2 |
| audio | 0.01 | 0.15 | 1.8 |
| base node, encoders, ToF, cliff | 0.35 | 0.40 | 0.5 |
| N20 + DRV8833 | 0 | 0.20 | 7 |
| converter + BMS losses | 0.30 | 0.45 | 3 |
| **total** | **2.8–3.15 W** | **4.35–4.65 W** | **≈ 30–38 W** (pack ≤ 5 A) |

Runtime with 85 % usable:
* 3000 mAh (36.7 Wh): typical 7.9–8.4 h, idle 11.7–13.1 h.
* **3500 mAh (42.8 Wh): typical 9.2–9.8 h**, idle 13.6–15.3 h.
* Sleep (≈ 0.35 W): > 100 h.

The support polygon is the diamond of the wheels (±54, 0) and the casters (0, ±34).

**Minimum clearances of moving parts (this layout):**
* **Lift servo, crank and FPC lift loop ↔ static torso internals: 1.25 mm.** The widened lift loop vs the front frame column at pan −60 to −66 was checked separately: ≥ 1.05 mm.
* **Neck foot + ear ↔ torso internals: 1.15.** Foot/ear ↔ well: 1.0.
* **Well corners (r 28.1) ↔ pan channel: 1.0** at every pan angle (K2's `gaps2.json` reported 0.6 from an older layout).
* **Pan stage + lift ↔ torso shell: 1.9.**
* **J1 rotating parts ↔ base: 1.0** over J1 ±155. Excluded: the 6805 inner ring on the hub (intended fit). The sun gear ↔ torso floor is also 1.0.
* **Arm ↔ torso: 1.0** (cap in the shoulder pocket). **Arm ↔ base: 5.0**, also over J1 ±150. The two arms never meet. **Arm ↔ head: ≥ 2.0** inside the firmware table; every table entry was re-verified with `distance_to`.
* **Intended contacts under 1 mm:**
  * collar disc/ring seam 0.25 (B);
  * pan journal running fit (envelope 0.4, real 0.05–0.1);
  * pan FPC inner run resting on the drum (0.4);
  * real head over the collar plateau 0.45 (re-run of `head_real_check.py`; B criterion ≥ 0.25);
  * real hinge lugs ↔ well 1.0.

## 5. Assembly order, service, hidden fasteners

**Base**
1. Heat-set inserts in the white top shell.
2. PETG chassis: motor clamps, **13 × 6 hub beam**, J1 hub (steel M8 core) with the slip-clutch brass sun gear, J1 channel with the FPC static anchor.
3. Motors, encoders and wheels.
4. PCBs:
   * node, DRV8833 and buck in the corner pockets beside the battery bays, above z 12;
   * BMS, charger, USB-C and switch on top of the battery groups, outside r 35;
   * ToF and LED bar at the front;
   * **cliff sensors in the corner pockets at z 8–11, under the boards**.
5. Dark bottom frame.
6. The two battery groups (series link + balance lead, XT30 + JST-XH, no hot glue) drop into the two bays from below.
   * Each bay is closed by a **cover that also carries the ball caster**, fixed with 2 × M2.
   * These are the only screws of the base, all on the underside.

**Torso**
1. Printed frame: cradle + deck + 4 columns + top journal ring.
2. STS3215 into the slotted cradle; brass pinion.
3. STS3032 + pinion.
4. Pan stage: pivot pin, PTFE washer, pan gear (stop pin), well, lift MG90S + crank.
5. Pan/lift FPC, from the drum anchor to the controller.
6. Controller, buck, amp, capacitor, speaker, LED bar, arm spline sockets with friction collars, cable spirals.
7. Shell:
   * the rear shell is screwed from the torso bottom, inside the plinth gap (invisible);
   * the front panel sits on 4 N52 magnets + 2 locating pins (the R01 front-panel seams).
8. Collar ring glued in.
9. Neck + head from above, per B montaz. Solder the FPC tail to the 7 neck wires in the foot channel, then screw the ear link to the foot through the back-wall window (rear shell off).
10. Torso onto the base: the 6805 snaps over the 3-finger POM collet lip of the hub (pull-off ≈ 30 N), the pinion meshes, and the J1 FPC is plugged in through the rear opening.

**Service**
* Battery: the bottom covers. The casters come off with them.
* USB-C and switch: on the back of the base.
* Arm servo: pull the arm off and unplug the JST-SH.
* Lift servo, controller, pan FPC: take the rear shell off.
* Pan servo: take the front panel off.
* STS3215: pull the torso off the collet.
* No screws on the top, front or sides.

## 6. What the soft exterior must respect (summary of `envelope.json`)

**Torso**
* The inner surface encloses the slice hulls of `envelope.json → torso_slices` (or `…without_shell_mounted_parts` when the side columns, journal ring and speaker are screwed to the shell).
* Minimum interior a ≥ 40.9 (b/a 0.9) → ≈ 86 × 78 outside with a 2.2 mm wall.
* Depth is set by the lift crank sweep (r 35.9 about Z, back half).
* Below z 53 only the centred STS3215 remains, so a soft rounded belly is free (R ≥ 15).

**Torso top**
* Flat collar plateau to r 29.8 at z 133.
* Beyond r 30 the top must stay **≥ 1 mm below z 133 in every direction** and under the head keep-out profile (`envelope.json → head_keepout_profile`).

**Torso bottom**
* Closed at z 43, except the Ø14 hole for the J1 spline.
* Flat zone ≥ r 22; the dark rotating skirt r 34 shows in the 3 mm gap as the R01 plinth ring.

**Shoulders**
* Axis X at (y 2, z 112).
* Torso half width ≤ 44.5 at shoulder height.
* Shoulder pocket r 13.5 from |x| 37.5.

**Arms**
* Paddle cavity at least |x| 46.5–67.5, y −4…8, z 90–118.5.
* Wall ≥ 2.0, rf ≥ 11. Each arm sweeps a disc of r 74 about the shoulder axis.

**Base**
* ≥ 140.4 × 109.8 between z 11 and 30 (the battery ends sit 1–2 mm from a 142 × 110 n 2.35 wall).
* Top flat to r 36 at z 40, with a top opening r 29.

**Base openings**
* Wheel slots 11 × 34 at x ±54.
* Caster holes Ø14 at (0, ±34), in the bay covers.
* Cliff windows 9 × 7 at (±40, ±31).
* ToF window front; USB-C + switch back.

**Wheels**
* The tyres show as a ≤ 6 mm dark sliver in the ground gap. Use black tyres and a recessed dark foot (inset ≥ 6 mm) to keep them in shadow – R01 shows no wheels.

## 7. Top risks / open items
1. **J1 gear mesh** under hand twisting → slip clutch + 15 % torque limit + re-homing are mandatory (both gears are now brass).
2. **Yaw backlash**: two gear pairs, ≈ 0.2–0.6° each → set the slotted cradle; a bias spring is an option.
3. **Zero vertical slack** above the STS3215 (top 80.5, deck 81.0) → measure the real servo; shim the cradle.
4. **Pan FPC on a half-toothed drum** is a novel arrangement. Fallback: a loose S-loop, which needs ≈ 8 mm more torso height (total 223).
5. **Arm/head interference** is inherent to the R01 proportions → firmware table. Verify 180° travel on the purchased slim servo; with an MG90S the paddle grows to ≈ 26 mm.
6. **Lift holding** away from the dead centres → MG90S hum; use dead-centre rest poses or a bus servo.
7. **Base corners**: the battery groups end 1–2 mm from the 142 × 110 placeholder wall → the exterior must keep ≥ 140.4 × 109.8 at z 11–30.
8. **Height 215**, the upper end of the range.

## Zhrnutie (SK)
* Toto je jediné finálne vnútorné usporiadanie trupu a podstavca. Vychádza z víťazného konceptu K2, má prevzaté nápady z K3 a opravené chyby, ktoré našlo hodnotenie.
* **Kĺby:**
  * Trup (J1) otáča Feetech STS3215 posunutý o 18 mm od osi cez mosadzné ozubenie 1 : 1 s trecou spojkou. Nesie ho ložisko 6805.
  * Hlavu (pan) otáča Feetech STS3032 vpredu cez prevod 2 : 1.
  * Zdvih krku robí MG90S s kľukou, ktorá má mŕtve body v oboch krajných polohách.
  * Ruky poháňajú tenké servá priamo v lopatkách, s trecou spojkou v ramene.
* **Opravy oproti K2:**
  * stena rúk 2,0 mm;
  * pevný nosník pod nábojom J1;
  * kolieska sú v kryte batérie a senzory okraja v rohoch, takže batérie sa dajú vybrať zospodu;
  * vodiče hlavy cez otáčanie a zdvih vedie jeden plochý FPC.
* **Rozmery:** trup najmenej ≈ 86 × 78 mm (R01 91 × 78), podstavec najmenej 140,4 × 109,8 mm, výška 215 mm. Zaoblený spodok trupu s tmavým prstencom ako na R01 je možný.
* **Kontroly:** 0 statických kolízií. V 41 polohách 0 nevyriešených kolízií: 10 prípadov ruka ↔ hlava zakazuje tabuľka limitov rúk, 3 sú artefakty zjednodušenej hlavy (skutočná hlava má ≥ 0,45 mm). Hmotnosť 911 g, ťažisko vo výške 74,5 mm. Robot sa prevráti až pri náklone 20,1° (v najhoršej polohe 15,8°).
* **Batérie:** odporúčam články 3500 mAh, s nimi je bežná výdrž ≈ 9,2–9,8 h.
